content:
For Windows development, I recommend using Chocolatey or winget:

1. Chocolatey (Most Popular):
- Open-source package manager
- Large package repository
- Command-line interface
- Easy installation of dev tools and software
- Works across Windows versions
- Supports scripting and automation

Install via PowerShell (Admin):
```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force; [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor 3072; iex ((New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1'))
```

Example usage:
```powershell
choco install git
choco install vscode
choco install nodejs
```

2. winget (Microsoft's Official Package Manager):
- Built into Windows 10/11
- Native Microsoft solution
- Growing package repository
- Simpler interface
- More lightweight

Install via Command Prompt:
```cmd
winget install Git.Git
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudioCode
```

Recommendation: Chocolatey for broader support and more packages.
